subject: [PATCH v2 07/17] selftests/mm: add folio-order detection self-check

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify that the vm_util folio-order detection helpers agree with the kernel about what backs a mapping. The test faults in memory with only one order enabled and checks that the helpers report exactly that order, not a neighbouring order or plain 4K memory as order 0. This ensures that the helpers are reliable before they are used by khugepaged mTHP tests to detect collapse results.
